messages:
Alex M.: FYI Helix is ready to start a 6-week POC but Security has a laundry list around SSO/SCIM/RBAC and domain proofing. Can we triage blockers and provide a small Dedicated quote?
Priya K.: List please. I can own procurement and pricing. Do they want automated role provisioning or just SSO SAML auth?
Jordan L.: They want full lifecycle: SCIM user + group push -> map to Redwood roles, SAML for SP-initiated SSO, and domain locking so only their tenant can claim helix.com. Also asked about delegated admins for their SRE team.
Mike C.: Implementation notes: we support SCIM v2 (Users + Groups), can do group->role mapping via groups.displayName -> redwood role. Example SCIM create user payload: ```POST /scim/v2/Users {"userName":"jane@helix.com","emails":[{"value":"jane@helix.com"}],"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"]}```
Priya K.: For pricing: Helix expects 250 users, 25 admins, POC 6 weeks, baseline load ~60 concurrent tokens/s. I'll model a small Dedicated slot + overage. Need to know if we must reserve GPU capacity for their POC.
Jordan L.: For 60 concur, a single reserved 8xA100-equivalent slot should be fine with autoscale bump. Also flag: they require SCIM bulk import (CSV -> SCIM PATCH) and SCIM rate limit increase for initial sync.
Alex M.: Security asked for: MFA enforced via IdP, SAML attribute mapping doc, SCIM audit logs retained for 90 days, KMS-backed keying for private deployments, and an ATO readiness checklist. Can SecOpsBot confirm we have docs?
SecOpsBot: Automated check: SOC2 report available (link DM), SAML mapping guide v1.2 in /docs/idp/, SCIM rate-limit and bulk-import playbook attached. KMS integration requires Private deployment + key config.
Mike C.: For domain proofing we require a TXT record at _redwood-verification.helix.com with token we issue. Once verified, domain gets a locked flag preventing other tenants claiming it. We'll also provide DNS TTL guidance.
Priya K.: Timeline: procurement/POC contract in 1 week if legal signs off. I'll draft a 6-week POC SOW and quote tonight. Jordan, can you produce a short onboarding checklist for their IdP team?
Jordan L.: Onboarding checklist (short): 1) send IdP metadata XML, 2) add our ACS & EntityID, 3) create SCIM admin token (scopes: Users, Groups), 4) provide initial CSV for bulk import, 5) add TXT to DNS for domain proofing. Paste this in kickoff invite.
Alex M.: Legal notes: Helix wants limited liability cap edits and standard data processing addendum. Legal will review; procurement contact is sara@helix.com.
Priya K.: Great. I'll include SCIM throughput bump and Dedicated slot option in the quote and call out any legal contingencies. @Jordan L. please prep a short demo for the kickoff. :thumbsup:
